title: Compiling web export gives debug build despite targeting release in python build profile
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.4 Stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

I'm exporting web templates and I noticed a weird quirk. Despite targeting template_release in my Python build script, it generated the debug export instead. This issue doesn't happen when I export my Windows build.

```py
#custom.py
target="template_release"
debug_symbols="no"
optimize="size"
lto="full"
```

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/160ba81c-e56f-4e5f-88b0-72d682114386)

It works properly when I explicitly mention it in the command itself

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e6e2e173-ce9e-44eb-bee5-968df1326d8b)

**Edit:** Here's it properly exporting the release template with the Windows build

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d3d09f0d-7878-4823-8b95-043c1b633a9a)

### Steps to reproduce

Create the python build config file with `target="template_release"` included, then compile the web build with `scons platform=web profile=custom.py`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot-size-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19150147/godot-size-test.zip)
